datasets.title: Bangladesh - Cox's Bazar Refugee Settlement Infrastructure
datasets.description: On behalf of the Global WASH Cluster, with funding provided by USAID and ECHO (September-December 2017) and UNICEF (January 2018 onwards), REACH initiated a rapid infrastructure mapping exercise in Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar District. This data collection exercise is now concluded, with Round 9 the final round.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cox-s-bazar-refugee-settlement-infrastructure]
datasets.details: THIS DATA COLLECTION EXERCISE IS NOW CONCLUDED, WITH ROUND 9 THE FINAL ROUND While the aim of this exercise is to map all infrastructure present, the dataset may not capture all infrastructure on site. Further, as sites are changing rapidly this dataset may not reflect the current infrastructure situation at the time of publication. Please note that the spatial accuracy of this dataset is at best just under 5m, which can influence the analysis of infrastructure coverage. Additionally, infrastructure coverage in this particular context may not be the best means of analyzing service delivery, as much of the infrastructure observed in the field is of sub-standard quality. More detailed information pertaining to the quality of infrastructure will be required at a later date.

lineage.description: REACH Initiative conducted repeated census-based infrastructure mapping exercises (9 rounds, September 2017–November 2018) across Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh, funded by USAID, ECHO, and UNICEF. Data collection involved systematic camp sweeps to enumerate and locate WASH infrastructure facilities, producing multi-temporal exposure inventories for humanitarian planning and resource allocation.
